title: LLM prompt-injection testing
preconditions: challenge model endpoint is the only target
use synthetic canaries, never real secrets
steps: Map what the model can see and do: system prompt, retrieved documents, tools, memory, and output channel.
Test direct override, role-play, delimiter confusion, and system-prompt leakage with benign probes.
For RAG/indirect injection, place the payload in a document the model retrieves; use a unique canary string to prove exfil.
Confirm impact with the smallest reproducible request; do not test unrelated public AI services.
falsifier: The model ignores injected instructions and no canary reaches an output/tool channel.
